title: Services page
description: Every service the business offers, one row each, with a way to ask when a visitor is not sure which they need.

copy_guidance.Eyebrow: The trade, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Heading: All the work the business does, and where, in a line.
copy_guidance.Body: One line on how to find the right service, or to ask when unsure.
copy_guidance.Primary button: The action for a visitor who knows what they need, such as Get a quote.

copy_guidance.Heading: The h2 over the full list, such as Everything we do.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on how the list is ordered, or the area it covers.
copy_guidance.Service 1 heading: The first service in Site Data's services list, or the site owner's first. Repeat the row for each one after it.
copy_guidance.Service 1 text: What that service covers, in one plain line. No price or promise unless the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: A question for a visitor who does not see their job listed, such as Not sure which you need?
copy_guidance.Body: One line on how the business helps them choose.
copy_guidance.Primary button: An action that asks for help choosing, such as Ask us.

copy_guidance.Heading: What customers say about the work, in a few words. No count or score.
What happens once a visitor asks about any service, in a few words, such as How it works.
copy_guidance.Step 1 heading: The first thing a visitor does, numbered 1, such as 1. Get in touch. Number each step after it in order.
copy_guidance.Step 1 text: What the visitor does or tells the business, in one plain line. No reply time unless the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: One short sentence that invites the visitor to get in touch about any service.
